Coram : KURIAN JOSEPH*, R. BANUMATHI
U.P. Urban Building Act - s.2J(a) - Eviction - On ground of bo.na fick requirement of the legal heirs of deceased landlord - Original owner-landlord filed an application for eviction on the ground of bona fide requirement for expansion of family business - Rent Appellate Authority reversed the finding and granted eviction, on finding that the premises was required for the business of the landlord - Aggrieved tenant filed writ petition before High Court - Meanwhile, landlord expired - High Court taking note of fact that landlord has expired, declined
Decision Date : 30-03-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1464/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
